src: tools/blender/sewers (export_modules.py: the owner's sewer GLBs as FBX in studs, one per metre, and the lane check; publish.py: the upload).
placement: InsertService:LoadAsset(assetId):GetChildren()[1] is a Model whose pivot is the FBX origin: the module's centre on its walkway top (junction: the centre of its floor). Pivot it to a slot's ArtPivot (Workspace.Sewers.<pipe>.Art.<slot>); each MeshPart arrives unrotated at its `centre` in the module frame (X across, Y up, Z along). Make every part visual only: the bake's Lining parts carry the collision, the camera and the light backing; once a pipe's slots are filled, set its Lining parts' Transparency to 1 (keep their collision).

brick.why: the channel handrails and footplates stand 0.99 off the axis, in the squirrel's lane (0.8..2.4)

brickPlain.why: the plain repeat: no footbridge, valve or label (a footbridge every 12 studs reads as a pattern), and no handrails (in the lane)

dryPlain.why: the plain repeat under the river: no pump set, service door, panel, valve, sign or plaque
